name: Current-measuring shunt
summary: A current-measuring shunt produces a documented voltage drop corresponding to current through a resistive element.
description: A current-measuring shunt produces a documented voltage drop corresponding to current through a resistive element. The drawing must distinguish the current path from the sensing leads.
readingNotes: Identify the separate measurement connections where the selected shunt provides them.

distinction: A shunt produces a voltage measurement without a current-transformer secondary.
